hook: Your body can be in four US states at once.
title: Stand in four US states at once
description: At the Four Corners Monument, Utah, Colorado, Arizona and New Mexico meet at a marker on the ground. Put a hand or foot on each quadrant and you are touching all four states. It is the only point in the US where four states meet.
comment_prompt: Would you do it? Yes or no
